title: The Falang multilanguage for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the……
description: The Falang multilanguage plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 1.4.6 is vulnerable to a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) flaw. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can exploit this vulnerability by injecting malicious scripts via a specific parameter. The vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The exploit is facilitated by the exposure of a required nonce to any logged-in user through an unprotected AJAX handler.
